Visa Sponsorship

ONS are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants are expected to hold a valid right to work in the UK when employment commences. If you are applying on a time-limited visa, this will need to be valid for at least 18 months at point of application.

To work at ONS, applicants must meet the Civil Service nationality requirements, satisfy UK right to work requirements and, where applicable, meet the relevant security clearance requirements. If you are unsure whether you meet the appropriate right to work or security clearance eligibility criteria, please refer to the guidance on Gov.uk or contact the recruitment email provided in the advert before applying

When a high volume of applications are received, the sift pass mark may be adjusted. Who We Are

Lennox (NYSE: LII)
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. What Drives Success

The Operations Research Analyst is responsible for applying advanced analytical, mathematical, statistical, and optimization techniques to solve complex business problems and improve operational performance. This role partners with cross-functional teams to analyze data, evaluate scenarios, develop predictive models, and provide actionable recommendations that drive efficiency, cost savings, service improvements, and strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Modeling

Develop and maintain statistical, optimization, simulation, and forecasting models to support business decisions.
Analyze operational, supply chain, financial, and business data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to evaluate strategic alternatives.
Design mathematical models for inventory optimization, network design, production planning, capacity planning, and resource allocation.

Business Performance Improvement

Identify process inefficiencies and recommend data-driven solutions to improve productivity, quality, and customer service.
Quantify the financial impact of proposed initiatives and operational changes.
Support continuous improvement efforts through analytical insights and performance measurement.
Monitor key business metrics and develop recommendations to enhance operational performance.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Collect, cleanse, validate, and analyze data from multiple enterprise systems.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Translate complex analytical results into clear business recommendations.
Present findings and strategic insights to management and cross-functional teams.

Collaboration & Project Support

Provide analytical expertise for business transformation initiatives.

Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Preferred Education

Master's degree in Operations Research, or related discipline.

Required Experience

5 years of experience in operations research, analytics, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, or business optimization.
Experience applying quantitative methods to solve business problems.
Experience working with large datasets and analytical tools.

Required Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Knowledge of optimization techniques, linear programming, simulation, forecasting, and statistical analysis.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience with Python, R, SQL, or other analytical programming languages.
Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong project management and organizational skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with supply chain optimization and inventory management.
Knowledge of machine learning and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with SAP ERP.
Experience with optimization mathematics and tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, SAS, or AnyLogic.

Work Environment

Full-time office environment with collaboration across multiple business functions.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
Occasional travel may be required to support operational sites and project initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A successful Operations Research Analyst combines strong quantitative and technical capabilities with business acumen. They are curious, detail-oriented, and able to transform complex data into practical recommendations that improve operational and financial outcomes.

What We Offer

Compensation
: This is a salaried exempt role. The starting salary range for this role and market is between $91,000 - $119,700
annually. Factors that may affect starting salary include geography/market and the skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Depending on date of hire, and subject to applicable eligibility requirements, new employees in this role also receive up to: 12 days paid time off, 2 paid well-being days, 1 paid volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, and 3 floating holidays per year.

Our Culture

Lennox is not just a workplace; we are a global community that values each team member’s contributions. Samsara's Core IT team builds the systems, processes, and experiences that let every team at Samsara do its best work. You'll lead a team, partner closely with internal stakeholders, and leverage external vendors and partners to scale impact across business operations.

This role will be eligible for remote work. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role, you will:

Own vendor management for Core IT's SaaS and hardware contracts.

Manage and develop direct reports, setting priorities across their combined scope and growing the team's capabilities and impact as the function's mandate expands.

Minimum requirements for the role:

5+ years of experience in vendor management, SaaS operations, IT business operations, or a related discipline, including experience managing enterprise software or hardware contracts end to end: negotiation, renewal, and spend tracking.

This Position reports to:

Global Payroll Transformation and M&A Lead

Your Role: Own the Challenge

As ABB Robotics embarks on its journey as a standalone global leader in automation, we are looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager to lead end-to-end payroll system implementation projects across multiple countries, as well as local discovery initiatives related to Payroll, Employee Life Cycle (ELC), and Time & Attendance processes.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering payroll transformation initiatives while ensuring compliance, stakeholder alignment, and a successful transition to ongoing operations. This position requires strong project management expertise, in-depth payroll knowledge, experience managing third-party vendors, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a dynamic global environment.

The work model for the role is: Remote

This role will functionally report to Global Payroll Transformation Lead who will act as an overarching Program Manager. Preferred candidates are from Mexico or US.

Lead payroll implementation projects from initiation through go-live and stabilization.
Drive local country discovery workshops to understand current state processes and help define future-state solutions.
Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, risk registers, and status reports.
Coordinate activities across HR, Finance, IT, payroll vendors, and other key stakeholders.
Manage payroll system implementations, working closely with integration and data migration teams.
Ensure payroll processes comply with local labor laws, tax regulations, and company policies.
Facilitate workshops to gather business requirements and document functional specifications.
Oversee testing activities, including SIT, UAT, parallel payroll runs, and issue resolution.
Monitor project budgets, resources, and timelines to ensure successful delivery.
Identify project risks and proactively implement mitigation plans.
Provide regular communication and project updates to executive stakeholders.
Support organizational change management, training activities, and transition to business-as-usual operations.
Ensure effective post-implementation support and successful project closure.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
5+ years of project management experience in payroll and HR transformation projects.
Proven experience leading payroll implementations in US and LATAM within managed services environments.
Experience with implementation of a global payroll provider is a must, if it was Strada is a plus.
Strong understanding of payroll operations, compliance requirements, and payroll-related controls.
Fluent English required; advanced Spanish and/or Portuguese is a strong advantage.
Hands-on experience with Workday is a plus.
Experience designing and implementing Workday-to-Payroll integrations.
Experience supporting divestiture or separation programs is highly desirable.
Experience working with global and cross-functional teams.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
High level of accountability with a proactive, collaborative, and partnership-oriented mindset.
Strong attention to detail and execution excellence.
Flexibility to support multiple global time zones.
Willingness to travel for workshops and key project milestones as needed.

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Land Development
new_jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

The Senior Project Manager is a senior practitioner within Westwood's Land Development team who plays a key role in driving business growth through strategic marketing and work-winning efforts. This position is responsible in supporting the building and expanding of client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, developing marketing pursuit strategies, and crafting compelling proposals to secure new work for residential, commercial, and institutional clients. In parallel, the Senior Project Manager oversees the full lifecycle of civil engineering projects - from preliminary studies through final design and construction administration - ensuring that client relationships cultivated through business development translate into successfully delivered, high-quality projects.

This role takes ownership of client relationship management across multiple concurrent pursuits and assignments, positioning Westwood competitively in the marketplace while also directing project scope, budget, schedule, and quality. The Senior Project Manager directly leads and develops the civil team(s) assigned to deliver projects won through these business development efforts.

With a minimum of 8 years of total experience, including at least 4 years as a project manager, the Senior Project Manager brings proven success in client development, proposal writing, and marketing strategy, alongside mastery of land development civil engineering principles, cost estimating, construction methods, and alternative delivery approaches. This individual serves as a key driver of the firm's growth pipeline, representing Westwood at industry events, cultivating repeat business, and pursuing new client relationships - while also playing an active role in staff development by training, mentoring, and guiding the professional growth of engineers and technicians on the team.

This is a fully remote position for candidates located in the greater Sacramento area.

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities:

Coordinate with Developers, Builders, Owners, Architects, and other outside team members to execute projects and manage multi-party project workflows.
Prepare proposals, scopes of work, and qualification packages, and develop and implement marketing pursuit strategies to win new work.
Build and develop relationships with clients, peers, and public agency staff to support long-term business growth.
Develop and direct civil project team(s) to plan, coordinate, and deliver civil consulting services and project deliverables.
Manage land development civil engineering projects for residential, commercial, and institutional clients efficiently, ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgets, and quality standards throughout all project phases.
Effectively manage internal support disciplines - including survey, traffic, hydrology and hydraulics, and others - communicating and managing technical details, schedules, and budgets across disciplines.
Implement and enforce the firm's QA/QC program across all assigned project teams and deliverables.
Work with City, County, and Utility staff to secure approval of project plans and resolve agency review comments.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, allocating resources appropriately across differing project phases and priorities.
Administer construction services activities on assigned projects, including RFI responses, site meetings with contractors, and construction observation.
Lead and manage technical personnel, including pursuing and assisting in hiring staff, assigning and overseeing project assignments, reviewing work for accuracy and completeness, training staff and promoting professional development, maintaining job satisfaction and morale, assisting with performance evaluations, and recommending compensation adjustments and promotions.
Manage project financial performance, including accounts receivable, invoicing, and budget tracking, ensuring projects are delivered profitably.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited university or college. Degrees in other disciplines or equivalent experience may be substituted at management's discretion.
Minimum of 10 years of total civil engineering experience, including at least 4 years in a Project Manager or equivalent leadership role.
Demonstrated competence in fundamental civil engineering design principles for land development projects.
Experience in cost estimating, bid phase assistance, construction administration, and general construction methods.
Demonstrated ability to manage design projects profitably, including budget tracking, invoicing, and accounts receivable management.
Experience preparing proposals, scopes of work, qualification packages, and marketing pursuit strategies.
Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and Microsoft Office applications.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
Demonstrated ability to manage staff and direct resources effectively across multiple concurrent projects.
Willingness to travel to project sites and other Westwood offices as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but not required for consideration:

Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in California (or capable of obtaining within 6 months).
Experience with alternative project delivery methods.
Established relationships with residential and commercial developers, builders, or public agency staff in the relevant market.
Track record of successfully winning and delivering projects across varied land development sectors.

Competencies Required

Business Development: Identifies and pursues new opportunities, maintains a strong professional network, and contributes to the firm's revenue growth.
Client Relationship Management: Builds trusted, long-term client relationships by serving as a reliable advisor who anticipates needs and exceeds expectations.
Technical Proficiency: Applies discipline-specific knowledge, codes, and engineering principles to produce accurate, high-quality work.
Quality Assurance & Control: Takes ownership of deliverable accuracy and completeness through disciplined review processes and adherence to Westwood's QA/QC standards.

Banque de Développement du Canada (BDC)

Montréal

Hybride - présence obligatoire au bureau 3 jours par semaine

37,5 heures - temps plein

24 mois

À déterminer

Niveau recherché :

Senior - 10+ années d’expérience

À propos du poste

BDC recherche un(e) Senior Project Manager spécialisé(e) en Microsoft Power Platform et gouvernance d’entreprise pour prendre en charge une initiative stratégique à haute visibilité.

Le mandat va au-delà de la gestion traditionnelle de projet. La personne sera responsable de mettre en place des fondations de gouvernance durables permettant à plusieurs initiatives actuelles et futures de se développer de manière sécuritaire, contrôlée et évolutive.

Cela comprend notamment la définition de cadres de gouvernance, politiques, environnements, contrôles, modèles opérationnels et façons de travailler, particulièrement autour de Microsoft Power Platform et des écosystèmes M365/Dynamics 365.

Le/la PM travaillera étroitement avec les sponsors exécutifs, Product Owners, équipes de livraison, architecture, sécurité, opérations et partenaires externes. Le rôle nécessite donc une excellente compréhension des environnements technologiques ainsi qu’une forte capacité à gérer des dépendances complexes et à influencer des parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.

Exigences et compétences techniques

Exigences principales

10+ années d’expérience en TI.
Minimum de 5 années d’expérience en leadership de programmes ou projets.
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projets ou programmes de transformation d’entreprise complexes et à grande échelle.
Expérience concrète dans la conception, l’implantation et l’institutionnalisation d’une gouvernance d’entreprise Microsoft Power Platform.
Expérience avec les environnements connexes Microsoft 365 et/ou Dynamics 365.
Solide compréhension de Microsoft Power Platform, de l’architecture d’entreprise et des stratégies d’intégration.
Expérience dans la création de cadres de gouvernance comprenant notamment :
Politiques
Environnements
Contrôles
Modèles opérationnels
Processus et responsabilités

Expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs workstreams, plateformes et équipes interdépendantes.
Expérience avec des partenaires et fournisseurs externes.
Expérience en gestion des risques opérationnels, technologiques, de conformité et de livraison.
Expérience en gestion du changement et contrôle de portée.
Expérience dans la transition d’un projet vers les opérations / steady-state.
Expérience en gestion budgétaire et suivi des bénéfices.
Expérience en production de rapports et présentations de niveau exécutif.
Solide expérience des approches Agile et hybrides.
Expérience en leadership Agile auprès de plusieurs squads et/ou partenaires de livraison.
Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projets et portefeuilles tels que MS Project / EPM.
Baccalauréat en administration, TI ou domaine connexe.
Bilinguisme français/anglais obligatoire.

Atouts

Maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent.
Certification en gestion de projet, telle que PMP ou équivalent.
Expérience approfondie avec Dynamics 365 / Microsoft 365.
Expérience dans des initiatives d’adoption de nouvelles technologies à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

Objectifs et livrables

Établir une gouvernance Power Platform durable et évolutive à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Définir les politiques, contrôles, modèles opérationnels et façons de travailler nécessaires.
Élaborer et maintenir la roadmap globale de l’initiative.
Définir la structure de gouvernance et les indicateurs de performance.
Assurer l’alignement des différentes initiatives dépendantes.
Gérer les interdépendances entre plateformes, équipes et flux de livraison.
Permettre une adoption sécuritaire et durable de Power Platform.
Gérer l’évolution de la portée et de l’état cible dans un contexte de transformation.
Planifier la transition du mode projet vers les opérations courantes.
Assurer la réalisation des bénéfices attendus.
Soutenir la gestion du changement et l’adoption par les utilisateurs.
Assurer le respect de la méthodologie de projet et des standards d’entreprise de BDC.

Responsabilités principales

Diriger l’initiative de la planification jusqu’à l’exécution et la clôture.
Définir la portée, les objectifs, livrables et critères de succès.
Développer et maintenir les plans de projet détaillés et la roadmap.
Mettre en place et faire évoluer le cadre de gouvernance Microsoft Power Platform.
Coordonner les parties prenantes des secteurs affaires, TI, architecture, sécurité et opérations.
Collaborer avec les sponsors exécutifs, Product Owners et équipes de livraison.
Clarifier les responsabilités et faciliter la prise de décision.
Gérer les dépendances entre les différentes initiatives et plateformes.
Assurer le séquencement approprié des livrables.
Identifier, suivre et atténuer les risques transversaux.
Gérer les changements de portée et de priorités.
Piloter la livraison de façon itérative lorsque l’état cible évolue.
Coordonner les fournisseurs et partenaires externes et suivre leurs engagements contractuels.
Assurer le suivi du budget, des échéanciers et des résultats.
Mettre en place des pratiques robustes de contrôle des changements et de réalisation des bénéfices.
Produire des rapports exécutifs sur l’avancement, les risques, décisions et résultats.
Planifier et coordonner la transition vers les opérations courantes.
Soutenir les stratégies de gestion du changement et d’adoption.
Promouvoir les pratiques Agile et l’amélioration continue.

L2C Program

Job Description

Role

Supply Chain: IT Project Manager

Onshore / Offshore

Onshore

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves together and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.

Job Description

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking
, with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet
. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of the Lead-to-Cash (L2C) program
, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a single platform
, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.

As part of a fast-moving, multi-year transformation
, the team will stabilize near-term operations, migrate core
platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally
, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders
on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.

For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help build a new business unit from its earliest days
, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale platform integration and cross-functional program leadership
, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

Workstream-Specific Details

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of Supply Chain IT projects within the L2C program, covering scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, risk, and quality across the full project lifecycle.
Build and maintain integrated project plans spanning quoting, ordering, and fulfillment workstreams, and manage dependencies with platform migration, data, and integration teams.
Drive day-to-day execution rhythm — stand-ups, sprint and release planning, status reporting, steering committee updates, and decision logs.
Manage supplier and systems-integrator partners against agreed statements of work, milestones, and service levels.
Own the risk, issue, action, and decision (RAID) register; escalate blockers early with clear options and recommendations.
Coordinate business readiness activities — process design sign-off, UAT, cutover planning, hypercare, and go-live support — with Supply Chain and Operations stakeholders.
Manage financials for assigned projects, including forecasting, accruals, purchase requisitions, and variance analysis against approved budget.
Ensure compliance with HPE project governance, change control, architecture review, and security and audit requirements.
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to business leaders and IT architects with executive-level clarity.
Capture and share lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of program delivery standards and templates.

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field; master's degree an asset.
8+ years of IT project or program management experience, including 5+ years leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional delivery.
Demonstrated experience delivering Supply Chain, ERP, or Lead-to-Cash / order management platform implementations or migrations (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent).
Experience managing third-party suppliers and systems integrators, including onshore/offshore delivery models across multiple time zones.
Track record of delivery in large-scale transformation, M&A integration, or legacy system consolidation programs.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum (CSM, PSM), or SAFe certification preferred.

Knowledge And Skills

Strong command of project management disciplines — planning, estimating, dependency management, critical path, change control, and financial tracking.
Fluency in both Agile and hybrid/waterfall delivery methods, with judgment on when to apply each.
Working knowledge of Supply Chain and L2C process areas: quote-to-order, order management, fulfillment, logistics, and supplier onboarding.
Understanding of enterprise integration concepts (APIs, middleware, data migration, master data) sufficient to challenge and align technical plans.
Proficiency with delivery and reporting tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, MS Project, Confluence, and Power BI.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills; able to translate technical detail into business impact.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias for structured decision-making under ambiguity.
Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across business, IT, and partner teams.
Comfortable operating at pace in a high-visibility, rapidly changing environment with competing priorities.
Attention to detail and disciplined follow-through on commitments, actions, and escalations.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Thales people architect solutions that are relied upon to deliver operational advantage at every decisive moment throughout the mission. Defence and armed forces customers rely on us to deliver the full range of defensive systems for land, sea, and air. From early warning, to threat neutralisation, our platforms cover all levels from very short-range systems, to extended protection across the entire battle-space including Airspace Mobility Solutions, Vehicles and Tactical Systems and Missile Defence, Optronics, and Radar.

Program Manager

Salt Lake City, UT (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales is looking for a Program Manager
with experience managing production programs. Reporting to the Director, ATM Programs, this role is responsible for the execution of assigned customer programs from sales handover through final system delivery and closure of contractual commitments.

In this position, you will also lead day-to-day program execution and coordinates cross-functional teams to meet customer requirements, contractual obligations, schedule commitments, quality standards, and cost objectives. The role manages program risks, tracks financial and schedule performance, and serves as the primary customer interface for assigned programs while escalating significant issues and risks as appropriate.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Manage Customer Relationships: Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned programs; Communicate program status, milestones, risks, and issues to customers in a timely manner; Coordinate customer deliverables and dependencies to support program execution; Plan and conduct program reviews, including customer acceptance reviews; Process contract modifications and change requests in accordance with established company procedures; Coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Finance teams to support successful program delivery.
Deliver Program Commitments: Execute programs in accordance with contractual requirements, approved schedules, and quality standards; Monitor program performance against cost, schedule, and technical objectives; Identify, assess, and manage program risks and opportunities; Escalate significant issues that may impact contractual commitments, schedule performance, or customer satisfaction.
Program Planning and Control: Develop and maintain program schedules, budgets, forecasts, and resource plans; Support development and maintenance of program baselines; Monitor estimated cost at completion (EAC) and update forecasts regularly; Track program progress and coordinate resolution of issues affecting execution; Prepare program metrics, dashboards, and status reports for management review; Support achievement of program profitability and performance objectives.
Lead Cross-Functional Program Teams: Coordinate and prioritize activities among cross-functional team members; Assign and track work packages to support successful program execution; Facilitate communication among project stakeholders; Monitor scope, schedule, and budget performance throughout the program lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related field and 5+ years of program or project management experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience managing customer-facing projects or programs in a manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or technology environment.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage program scope, schedule, cost, and risk.
Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent.
Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in project management with the US DoD or FAA.
Knowledge and experience with Federal Acquisitions Regulations (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisitions Regulations (DFAR).
Working knowledge of complex avionics, navigational aids and aircraft systems.
Working knowledge of high mix low-rate electronics and light mechanical Manufacturing is an asset.
Engineering degree or PMP or IPMA certification is an asset.
Experience with SAP by Design is an asset.

Special Position Requirements

Schedule: Core hours, Monday – Friday. A 9/80 shift is also offered with this role.
Physical Environment: Typical office environment – no special physical requirements.
Travel: This position may require domestic travel 25%.
Regulatory Compliance Requirements: None.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The world’s most consequential systems need the world’s best builders.

A new era is taking shape. AI is no longer confined to models or interfaces. It is becoming the foundation of how decisions are made across governments, industries, and real-world environments. What matters now is not just access to capability, but how it is applied, controlled, and sustained over time.

Torch.AI builds a government-owned reasoning infrastructure which creates a Reasoning Layer to enable machine reasoning at scale, in environments where it is hardest to achieve and least tolerant of failure. This is not incremental software. It is long-term infrastructure designed to endure, integrate, and evolve alongside the systems it supports.

Not another dashboard. Not another workflow app. Not another black-box model glued to a PowerPoint.

The Reasoning Layer is a modular architecture where data is connected, governed, transformed, represented, fused, reasoned over, and delivered into mission applications and operational workflows. It does not replace systems of record. It enables them to function better together.

The Reasoning Layer is comprised of: ORCUS (ingestion, orchestration, governance), NEXUS (semantic representation, vectorization), HALO (graph-based fusion and reasoning) and various product and capability components deployed for specific customer use cases.

We are seeking candidates who approach problems creatively, are comfortable operating without full clarity, and take responsibility for outcomes, not just implementation.

If you’re driven to strengthen U.S. defense readiness and protect national interests, Torch.AI offers meaningful impact at national scale.

What Makes Torch.AI Different

Torch.AI was founded on a simple operational insight: better use of data leads to better decisions. As data volumes increased across commercial, enterprise, and national security environments, the limiting factor was not collection, storage, or user interface design. The missing layer was machine understanding. And an infrastructure that could operate and reason between layers, preserve context, reconcile meaning, and make data useful for decisions in real time.

We believe the government must own its data and decision environment. In mission and operational environments, the layer where data becomes context, context informs models, models support decisions, and decisions shape action cannot be controlled entirely by private technology vendors.

Ownership does not mean the government must build every component itself. It means the government maintains stewardship and authority over the mission and operational layer. Commercial software, models, and services can contribute to the environment, but they should not capture the mission.

We are craftsmen.

We build with intention.

We ship with discipline.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, data experts, veterans, and mission practitioners. You’ll own meaningful work, move quickly, and see your systems deployed in production, often within weeks.

We are fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven. Every day is a new puzzle.

The Type Of Candidates Who Thrive

People who do well here tend to approach problems similarly.

They are comfortable operating without full clarity.
They pay attention to what actually happens, not just what was intended.
They are willing to be wrong, adjust quickly, and improve based on real feedback.
They take responsibility for outcomes, not just implementation.

This is not a good fit for someone who needs tightly defined problems or prefers distance from how their work is used.

Security Clearance

Some roles require an active Secret, Top Secret, or Top Secret/SCI
clearance. Where required, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate clearance level.

U.S. citizenship is required for all positions. Torch.AI does not sponsor employment visas.

If you do not currently hold a clearance but are eligible, sponsorship may be available depending on role and mission requirements.

Work Location

Most roles are based at our headquarters in Leawood, KS. Some hybrid/remote positions across the Arlington, VA, Washington, DC, and Maryland (DMV) region are available. Limited travel (

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Factory Automation
new_jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

The Factory Automation team designs, builds, and commissions 'from scratch' automated manufacturing and test systems across all Blue Origin sites. As the Technical Program Manager on the Factory Automation team, you will directly support Blue Origin’s success by building, maintaining, and evolving the program-level infrastructure and systems to enable rapid, lightweight, and effective project management across the organization - this is not
a project manager role, this is a program-wide role that enables the engineers, managers, and stakeholders working on automation development to track, measure, and understand the projects that form the overall automation program.

The ideal candidate will have professional expertise in program/project management, technical leadership, and a proven track record of successfully delivering automation projects on time and within budget. The person in this role will develop the systems to handle individual project technical scope definition, schedules, budgets, material procurement and resource allocation to complete projects, working directly with the Factory Automation development and integration engineering teams to ensure project completion on schedule and within the allocated budget. Success in this role will mean a decrease in project management effort for project leaders, and an increase in visibility into insights for the automation program - both internally and for our customers.

We are looking for a program manager to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities

Lead and manage the end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of multiple technical projects, supporting project leaders with planning, scheduling, procurement, resource allocation, and budget management
Develop and maintain systems and tools that enable lightweight project management (e.g. budget tracking, schedule compliance)
Coordinate with engineering teams to define, monitor and control project scope, goals, and final products
Proactively supervise and control project scope, manage change requests, and track risks and opportunities for multiple projects
Supervise key performance indicators and report out at program monthly reviews.
Manage the preparation, execution, and closeout of follow-up actions for Gated Reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR)
Develop procurement packages, perform bid leveling, and manage external subcontracts (minimum Fixed-Price and Time & Materials) in support of project efforts
Perform audits and continual improvement of project management tools and apply structure to how a growing organization manages multiple projects

Minimum Qualifications

6+ years experience managing sophisticated engineering system development projects within the aerospace, automotive, or other manufacturing industries
Understands theory and practical application of the Program/Project Management field
Prior execution of multiple projects to successful completion, on budget and on time, and ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
Proven experience developing custom project management tools, or adapting COTS systems to automate as many aspects of day-to-day project manage as possible
Demonstrated knowledge and application of project management principles on complex, multi-disciplinary systems, including project planning, integrated master schedules, critical path, change management, and after-action reporting
Organized self-starter, capable of breaking down complex problems into traceable tasks and concisely presenting project status
Recognize and act on opportunities; maintain flexibility to adjust as requirements shift or constraints change
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
Effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to identify and tailor to a target audience. Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

B.S. degree or higher in engineering or equivalent
Prior experience working as a program manager in the following areas:
Manufacturing automation equipment development and integration
Complex electronic system design and development
Design, build and test of fluids and/or pressure systems
A demonstrated ability to interpret and review electrical and mechanical drawings
Experience using AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code) to build scrappy PM systems to fill the gaps where enterprise systems have deficiencies
Experience with some or all the following tools: MS Project, MS Project Web App or Project Online, Airtable, Tableau, Windchill, and JIRA
An understanding of world-class quality, attention to detail, and dedication

Base Pay Range For

WA applicants is $145,188.00 - $203,263.20

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.

new_jobs.description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

Scope:

Portfolio & Project Manager is to oversee and coordinate our portfolio of projects in the region to ensure that the management process runs effectively and smoothly and that we deliver on the agreed metrics. This position requires excellent project management skills, and good communication to report at all levels in the organization. This role will help to drive consistency and standardization across global R&D project tools and practice with ongoing support for future R&D advancement projects.

About The Team

The R&D team
, composed of experienced professionals across multiple geographies, plays a critical role in advancing the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. Their focus spans three strategic pillars:

Sustainability
: Implement and scale sustainable business practices across operations, with a focus on reducing environmental impact, maximizing circularity, and enhancing long-term value creation. Product Innovation
: Design and develop new and improved packaging solutions that address evolving customer needs across diverse industries and applications. Cost Innovation

We are seeking a Program Manager
with a strong engineering background to lead complex embedded systems programs supporting defense and space applications. This role requires a hands-on technical program leader who can work closely with engineering teams, understand technical tradeoffs, and drive disciplined execution across cost, schedule, scope, risk, compliance, and customer commitments.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment and is comfortable operating with limited information while bringing structure, urgency, and accountability to complex programs. This individual will work cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, contracts, finance, business development, customers, and executive leadership to ensure successful program delivery.

This role is well suited for someone who has experience in a startup, growth-stage company, or small-company environment where program managers are expected to wear multiple hats, solve problems proactively, and drive outcomes without waiting for perfect information.

In This Position, The Essential Functions Are

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of programs for defense and space customers.
Own program performance across cost, schedule, technical scope, risk, quality, contractual deliverables, and customer satisfaction.
Partner closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements, assess tradeoffs, identify risks, and ensure execution aligns with customer and contract requirements.
Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, risk registers, action trackers, customer deliverable trackers, and executive-level status reporting.
Drive cross-functional execution across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, contracts, finance, business development, and customer-facing teams.
Identify program risks, dependencies, and blockers early; develop mitigation plans and drive issues to closure.
Operate effectively in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete data while continuing to refine assumptions, plans, and priorities.

Support contract review, proposal input, statements of work, deliverables, milestones, and customer communications.
Partner with contracts and leadership to ensure program execution aligns with prime contract requirements, subcontractor flow-downs, customer expectations, and applicable compliance obligations.
Support compliance with applicable government contracting, export control, and defense program requirements, including DFARS and ITAR-related processes.
Communicate program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to internal leadership, external customers, and other key stakeholders.
Build strong customer relationships through disciplined execution, proactive communication, transparency, and ownership of outcomes.
Drive a culture of accountability, urgency, attention to detail, and continuous improvement across assigned programs.

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, mechanical engineering, or another related engineering discipline.

Experience supporting defense, space, or other highly regulated technical environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, resource-constrained, or startup-like environment.
Strong understanding of technical scope, program cost, schedule, risk, customer deliverables, and execution tradeoffs.
Experience reviewing or supporting contracts, statements of work, deliverable requirements, milestones, and customer obligations.
Working knowledge of DFARS, prime contracts, subcontractor flow-downs, and government contracting environments.
Familiarity with ITAR and export-controlled program environments.
Proven ability to bring structure to ambiguous situations and drive execution with limited data or direction.
Strong attention to detail, organizational discipline, and follow-through.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical program status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and customers.
Experience managing defense and/or space programs under different contract types, including firm-fixed-price, cost-plus, and other government contracting structures; working knowledge of Earned Value Management principles and cost/schedule performance tracking.
Willingness and ability to support program needs outside of normal business hours when required, including time-sensitive customer, supplier, or internal execution activities.

Experience with embedded software, electronics, avionics, spacecraft systems, defense electronics, communications systems, mission systems, or other mission-critical hardware/software products.
Experience supporting proposals, customer negotiations, change orders, contract modifications, and program financial reviews.
Advanced degree in engineering, business, or a related technical field.

Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

The Capital Projects directorate manages Major Systems Projects (MSPs) within the NNPP and has responsibility to recapitalize the capabilities of the Expended Core Facility (ECF) which is approaching the end of its life. The PMI subdivision is a multi-site organization consisting of one unit based at NRF and two units based at Bettis with additional personnel residing at Knolls. The current CP portfolio includes the Spent Fuel Handling Recapitalization Project (SFHP), the Naval Examination Acquisition Project (NEAP), and the Interim Irradiation Examinations Recapitalization (IIER) project. The Project Management and Integration (PMI) subdivision is responsible for delivery and application of enhanced tools for work planning, performance management, risk management, delivery of budgetary work products, and overall integration of tools and communications across and external to the department. Additionally, PMI is the primary interface with the RS Directorate Management Office (DMO) and teams with the DMO on strategic and tactical decision-making.

PMI is seeking an advisor program manager who can provide leadership, functional expertise, and mentorship in project management tools and application, as well as leadership in communications to audiences both internal and external to the project(s). The advisor PM will administer all aspects of the management reserve methodology and will mentor control account managers on estimating costs and uncertainties, and identifying, quantifying and managing risks and opportunities. The PM will also partner with the senior leadership team to develop and influence key communications to provide a project perspective that is tailored to the audience.

The successful candidate should understand project management processes, and have the capacity to understand project performance data at a detailed level but be able to communicate key takeaways at a high level. The advisor PM serves as the “conscience of the project” as informed by significant NNPP experience. The ability to communicate with a diverse set of project stakeholders, support organizations, and Naval Reactors personnel is essential. This position also assists the senior leadership team in strategic direction for the individual projects, and the department as a whole.

Project management tools and processes are largely in place for the Spent Fuel Handling Recapitalization Project (SFHP). The Naval Examination Acquisition Project (NEAP) has established the mission need, certified their earned value management system, and is proceeding into final design, but has yet to set the total project cost, providing an opportunity for the advisor PM to draw on SFHP lessons learned as well as industry practices to identify improved tools or processes to streamline NEAP, IIER, and future MSP communications and reporting.

Familiarity with Naval Reactors DOE Order Implementation Bulletin (IB) 413.3-109, DOE Order 413.3B, and the Critical Decision process

Previous management experience

Students are our top priority.
We strive for excellence.
We thrive on diversity.
We celebrate collaboration.
We champion innovation.

For over 40 years, BAE Systems has served as the trusted agent to provide Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) of Navy, Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD), and foreign Military Sales (FMS) Weapon and Combat System Development. Our program is seeking a seasoned Technical Project Manager to direct and mentor a team of engineering Baseline Coordinators (BLCs) supporting the USN and BMD portfolios.

In this role, the successful candidate will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight, serving as the primary liaison between BAE Senior Leadership, government customers, and technical subtask divisions. This position is responsible for the end-to-end management of project execution plans, the alignment of technical and business resources, and the rigorous oversight of project budgets and schedules. The candidate will be expected to drive productivity, quality, and client satisfaction while providing high-level analytical guidance to the BLC team.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

Direct and manage a team of Baseline Coordinators (BLCs), providing the guidance and oversight necessary to execute all technical taskings across the USN and BMD portfolios.
Mentor BLCs in the execution of technical reviews, ensuring all deliverables meet quality standards and program objectives.
Coordinate all Systems Engineering (SE), Test & Evaluation (T&E), Cyber, and ILS efforts directed by the AEGIS TECHREP Project Lead.
Assess ongoing baseline efforts and oversee the compilation of weekly SITREPs and monthly reports to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
Conduct monthly team meetings to evaluate product line progress and ensure all customer requirements are being fulfilled.

Financial Management & Strategic Planning

Partner with Senior Leadership to develop project scope, utilizing financial expertise to build comprehensive Task Planning Sheets (TPSs) and Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates.
Lead the coordination, planning, and execution of monthly financial synchronization meetings with sponsors to ensure budget alignment and transparency.
Review project budgets and resource allocations, identifying variances and developing mitigation strategies to maintain financial health.
Support the BAE Senior Leadership Team in developing strategic roadmaps, project plans, and high-level demonstrations.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management

Develop and maintain strategic professional relationships with AEGIS TECHREP USN and BMD Division Heads, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact.
Foster cooperative partnerships with government project leads and subtask leaders to streamline communication and project execution.
Coordinate comment consolidation and adjudication meetings with all relevant parties for Milestone Technical Data Packages (TDP).

Technical Oversight & Execution

Oversee the BLC team in reviewing design plans and engineering processes, recommending changes to satisfy program objectives.
Direct the review and incorporation of comments for:
Element Final Specifications
SCRIBE and ETR documentation
Technical and Releasability Documents
Test Procedures

Ensure all TRAIN Action Item comments are routed to the applicable parties for adjudication.
Manage the closure of A-SPEC issues and other project comments in coordination with A-SPEC Engineers and originators.
Provide monthly executive summaries detailing changes to baseline schedules (Build plan, MPP, I&T) and maintain accurate records within the POA&M.
Oversee Build Package reviews and the submission of defect comments.
Manage and support all meeting requirements, including VTC, Teams, and CVTC coordination.
Submit and validate ATR Weekly Report inputs.

Minimum 15 years’ experience with DoD/DoN programs with a strong focus on Navy/AEGIS programs
Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in a related engineering field, or a minimum of 5 years of experience of in-depth specialized knowledge in the related field such as computer programming or equivalent experience
Proven people skills with the ability to nurture and mentor junior managers and team members
Ability to support a culture of diversity and inclusion
A desire to help others learn and grow within the organization
Proven customer service skills
Proven problem-solving and communication skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, etc.)
Experience with development and maintenance of computer programs
Understanding of the Systems Engineering Development Lifecycle

Overview
:
The Project Manager will play a key role in leading and coordinating enterprise level initiatives including Global Security transformation efforts, strategic technology projects, and other cross-functional initiatives approved through the Project Management Office (PMO) governance.
This role requires a PM who can manage complexity, enable executive decision-making, and drive disciplined execution across multiple high?visibility initiatives—often operating with incomplete information, evolving scope, and senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as project manager for multiple concurrent initiatives across the Global Security strategic portfolio, including transformation, technology enablement, and operational improvement efforts
• Translate leadership direction into clear project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and execution timelines.
• Maintain project visibility and accountability, drafting and updating core project documentation (e.g., 4?ups, business cases, project plans, RAIDs etc), facilitating stakeholder meetings, and following up with owners to ensure progress and closure.
• Manage and track progress across multiple initiatives, overseeing project intake, scheduling, timelines, milestones, and meeting cadence in alignment with Global Security PMO processes, while proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and capacity considerations to support timely decision?making.
• Arrange and facilitate regular stakeholder meetings.
• Measure project outcomes and success against organizational goals.
• Prepare materials for Steering Committee and leadership meetings, including status updates, decision briefs, risk summaries, and options analysis.
• Partner with cross?functional stakeholders including Business Technology Services (BTS), HR, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, EHS, Facilities, and regional Security teams to coordinate execution.
• Ensure technical, policy, training, and compliance requirements are identified and incorporated into project plans, partnering with stakeholders to support change communications, enable user adoption, and minimize resistance.
• Ensure project governance, process documentation, and training resources are developed, stored, and shared as appropriate.

Qualifications and Essential Skills, Experience, and Competencies

• Degree in a relevant subject area or equivalent experience gained through enterprise project or transformation work.
• 6+ years of experience managing complex, cross?functional projects or programs, with a demonstrated ability to move work forward in environments where priorities evolve.
• Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives at the same time, balancing scope, timelines, and capacity while keeping leadership informed of risks and tradeoffs.
• Strong business and operational acumen, with the ability to anticipate organizational needs, connect work to strategic intent, and help leaders make informed decisions.
• Experience leading or supporting enterprise?level initiatives in transformation, technology enablement, regulated environments, or security?adjacent functions.
• Comfortable working with senior leaders, governance bodies, and steering committees, including preparing leadership?ready materials and supporting decision?making forums.
• Strong cross?functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering across teams such as Technology, HR, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, EHS, Facilities, and regional operations to coordinate execution.
• Experience supporting or leading change management and communications efforts, including policy rollouts, training coordination, and adoption planning.
• Familiarity with security, compliance?driven, or regulated environments is strongly preferred, including comfort navigating risk, controls, audits, and policy requirements (deep technical expertise is not required).
• Strong understanding of project governance, portfolio management, and change management principles, with a bias toward disciplined execution and transparency.
• Clear, concise communicator with strong organizational skills and attention to detail, able to distill complexity into actionable next steps.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel); experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, or similar tools is a plus.
• Familiarity with security or enterprise systems (e.g., access management platforms, incident or mass?notification systems) is a plus, but not required.

What Success Looks Like

• Leadership has clear visibility into priorities, risks, and capacity, and can make informed decisions without surprise.
• Strategic initiatives move from approval to delivery with disciplined governance and minimal rework.
• Pilots result in clear scale / stop decisions and repeatable rollout plans.
• Cross?functional stakeholders view the PMO as a decision?enablement partner, not a reporting function.

What are the top 3-5 skills, experience or education required for this position:

1. Enterprise Project & Portfolio Management (Non Negotiable)

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities using a structured intake, sequencing, and delivery model.
• Comfortable operating at both project level execution and portfolio level tradeoff discussions (capacity, priority, timing).
• Experience supporting PMO governance, not just running isolated projects.
2. Executive & Steering Committee Enablement

• Demonstrated experience preparing leadership ready materials: decision briefs, status summaries, risks/tradeoffs, and options—not raw project updates.
• Skilled at framing work so leaders can clearly answer: approve, defer, change scope, or stop.
• Comfortable facilitating governance forums (SteerCo, leadership reviews) and following through on decisions.
3. Cross Functional Influence & Change Management

• Strong ability to work across Security, BTS, HR, Legal, Compliance, EHS, Facilities, and Regions—without formal authority.
• Experience supporting change management, communications, and training rollouts, especially where policy or behavior change is involved.
• Understands that adoption risk is just as critical as technical delivery.
4. Comfort in Regulated / Security Adjacent Environments

• Familiarity with security, compliance driven, or regulated environments (physical security, IT/security systems, pharma, manufacturing, privacy, safety).
• Understands concepts like risk, controls, audits, access management, and policy enforcement—even if they are not the technical expert.
5. Structured Thinking + Comfort with Ambiguity

? Ability to bring structure to unclear work, especially early stage initiatives coming out of Phoenix, AI exploration, or strategy discussions.
? Strong judgment on when to add rigor vs. keep things light, depending on risk and scale.
? Proactive, self directed, and comfortable iterating as strategy evolves.

Maîtrise d’outils de gestion de projet et portefeuille tels que MS Project / EPM.
Excellentes compétences en documentation et présentation.

Connaissance des plateformes CMS, DAM et personnalisation.

new_jobs.title: Founding Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Kaizen

Kaizen is a digital employee that helps healthcare providers get patients into care faster. It processes referrals, verifies insurance benefits, manages prior authorizations, and handles provider credentialing across the systems teams already use. Customers can give Kaizen feedback directly, teaching it their processes and refining how it works.

We recently raised $8.5M from Joe Lonsdale’s 8VC, Y Combinator, Jeff Dean, and Eric Schmidt’s Innovation Endeavors.
We’re hiring our first Deployment Strategist to help $100M+ healthcare providers drive seven-figure ROI with AI.

The opportunity

You’ll work directly with healthcare executives to identify where automation can create the most value, then use Kaizen to deliver it. With a digital employee that learns from customer feedback, you can deploy workflows in just two weeks that generate six figures in annual value
.

Your job is to understand the customer’s business, identify the right opportunities, and teach Kaizen how to execute. You’ll be equally comfortable discussing an ROI model with a CFO and sitting alongside an authorization specialist to understand why a case is stuck.

As Kaizen’s first Deployment Strategist
, you’ll work directly with the founders to build the function: how we deploy, how we measure success, and how we turn successful deployments into broader customer relationships. As we grow, you’ll have the opportunity to recruit, mentor, and lead the team around you.

What you’ll do

Find the highest-value opportunities.
Map customer operations, identify bottlenecks that delay care or leave revenue uncollected, and build a deployment roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes.
Teach Kaizen how the customer works.
Turn customer processes into live workflows, from processing referral faxes and checking benefits to submitting authorizations and completing provider enrollment applications. Help customers give feedback directly so Kaizen keeps improving.
Get deep into the details.
Learn the payer-specific requirements, system quirks, and exceptions that determine whether a workflow succeeds. Trace failures, close gaps, and make sure the automation works in the conditions customers actually face.
Own customer results.
Establish a baseline, agree on success metrics, and track improvements in processing time, staff capacity, and revenue. Use the results to guide expansion.
Lead the relationship.
Earn trust with executives and frontline teams, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and keep deployments moving when priorities or requirements change.
Build the function.
Establish our deployment practices, turn successful approaches into repeatable playbooks, and help hire and mentor future Deployment Strategists.
Influence the product.
Work closely with the founders and Engineering to solve recurring problems and translate customer needs into product improvements.

What you’ll bring

2+ years bringing software into the real world.
You’ve worked in solutions engineering, technical product management, integrations, software consulting, or AI deployment. You’ve translated business needs into working systems and stayed involved through launch.
Business judgment and executive communication.
You can work with healthcare leaders to identify opportunities to grow revenue, from converting more referrals into visits to preventing authorization delays and getting providers enrolled with payers sooner. You can quantify the opportunity and make a clear, compelling case to decision-makers.
Hands-on AI experience.
You’ve built or deployed solutions using LLMs, generative AI, or machine learning. You can explain how they work, evaluate their performance, and troubleshoot failures to make them reliable in practice.
Ownership and follow-through.
You take responsibility for outcomes, hold a high standard, and help others do their best work. You’re comfortable figuring out what needs to happen and driving it forward.

Experience deploying AI within a consulting firm or working with healthcare organizations is especially relevant. Healthcare experience isn’t required; curiosity about how care gets delivered is.

Why Kaizen

Build a function from the ground up, work directly with the founders, and own consequential customer relationships early in your career. You’ll have a product that lets you move quickly and a direct connection between your work and its impact: patients getting care sooner, staff spending less time on paperwork, and providers getting paid for the care they deliver.
